content_of_post_to_comment: Does anyone feel afraid or resistance to confront themselves. I feel like the reason I'm feeling down always and just distracting myself because I'm just somehow afraid of the feelings I will feel and the amount of regret and emotional pain it will come with because I know deep down how messed up my life is and it's all thanks to me because it's my fault that I didn't do the things I said I would do and failed to keep my promises and never walked my talk. I let myself down and those who believed in me.
comment: I think a lot of people avoid confronting themselves because they imagine it will be a moment of judgment, when it can actually be a moment of honesty. The fact that you can name the promises you broke means you’re already seeing things clearly. Try not to turn regret into a punishment session; use it as information about what needs to change. The person who let you down is also the person who can start rebuilding trust.
